name: Alante
description: A cleric of the Order of the Five Sacraments who leads a party and claims the Hierophant's Chalice.

description_citations.text: "Mavren Fein". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vona's agents fail to find the Temple of Aclazotz; Alante claims the chalice.
timeline.quote: her agents failed to locate the temple

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alante's party battles Mavren and Zotz at the temple; Zotz's death breaks its hold on Mavren and Alante takes the Hierophant's Chalice.
timeline.quote: When Zotz was killed, its death finally broke its hold on Mavren

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alante's party battles Mavren and Zotz; Zotz is killed, freeing Mavren from his hold.
timeline.quote: When Zotz was killed, its death finally broke its hold on Mavren

citation.text: "Arguel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alante finds Arguel's corpse and claims the Hierophant's Chalice for the Order of the Five Sacraments.
timeline.quote: Alante claimed the Hierophant's Chalice from Arguel's corpse

citation.text: "Arguel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alante turned against Vona, stole the map, freed the prisoners and led them to the Temple of Aclazotz, securing the Chalice for her order.
timeline.quote: Stealing the map, she freed the doomed prisoners and led them to the Temple of Aclazotz ahead of Vona’s forces, ultimately securing the Chalice for her order and thwarting Vona’s plan.
